note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. This chapter is Eliphaz speaking; the pictures show what his words say, through ordinary people and things of today. God is not pictured, Eliphaz and Job are not portrayed, and nothing violent is shown. 13 pictures chosen by eye from 24 trial pictures (2026-11-22); each section's "trials" says why.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures. What he said went wrong before: he could not tell why some pictures were there, could not connect them to the meaning, and some were too abstract.

sections.meaning: Cry out if you like, no one will answer, for resentment and jealousy are what kill the fool.
ideas: A lone man stands at the rim of a vast empty canyon, hands cupped round his mouth, calling out, with no one anywhere to answer
A weary man knocks on door after door along an empty street at dusk and every door stays shut
A man shouts into a telephone whose cord has been cut
A man calls out from a pier across a sea lost in fog
A bitter man sits hunched in a dark room glaring, fists clenched, while the plant on his sill withers
A jealous man stares over a fence at his neighbour's celebration, his face grey and hollow
A man shouts at the sky from a bare mountaintop
A man sits on the floor against a wall, his phone silent beside him
An empty bus stop at night where a man calls after a bus that has already gone
A man rings a bell at a locked gate before a dark house

trials.why: beat a1-doors: the man knocking at one door did not show that no one answers; the empty canyon shows it at once

sections.meaning: The fool who seemed firmly rooted is suddenly ruined: his home under a curse, his children with no one to help them, his harvest eaten by strangers.
ideas: A tall tree that grew fast beside a showy new house lies toppled, its shallow roots torn out of the ground, the house dark and empty
A grand house stands deserted, its garden gone to thorns, while hungry strangers reach through the brambles to pick the last fruit in its orchard
Strangers gather the harvest from a thorn-choked field while the owner's house stands empty
A weed with shallow roots lies pulled up and wilting in the sun
Two young men stand alone at a courthouse door with no one beside them
A once-lavish garden party table left out to rot, overgrown with weeds
A big house split by a sudden sinkhole
A tall tree blown over in a storm across a rich man's fence
A grand gate rusted shut with thorns grown through it
A mansion's empty swimming pool full of dead leaves

trials.why: kept with b1-orchard: the uprooted tree shows 'taking root, and suddenly', the orchard shows verse 5
kept with b1-tree (verse 5 is about 7 seconds, just enough for its own picture)

sections.meaning: Trouble does not spring up from the soil by itself; people are born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.
ideas: A man sits alone by a campfire at night watching a stream of sparks rise into the dark sky
A tall column of sparks streams straight up from a log fire over bare dark ground where nothing grows
Sparks fly up from a blacksmith's anvil
A welder's sparks shower upward
Embers drift upward over a dark lake
A bonfire in a bare field throwing sparks high into the night
Bare cracked ground with nothing growing in it
A father holds his newborn by a fireside as sparks rise
A chimney sending sparks into a winter night sky
Sparks rising from a burning brush pile in a cleared field

trials.why: beat c1-campfire: the same idea, but the sparks flying upward are far plainer and more striking

sections.meaning: Turn to God and lay your cause before him: he does wonders beyond number, sends rain on the dry earth, and lifts the lowly and the mourning to safety.
ideas: In the blue light before sunrise a man in work clothes sits in his parked pickup truck, hands folded on the wheel, head bowed in prayer
A man sits on a hilltop bench at first light with a worn notebook in his hands, face lifted to the sky as he speaks
A man sits on his porch steps at dawn, hat in his hands, head bowed
A man climbs a steep path toward a bright summit
A sky full of countless stars over a dark field
A poor farmer and his wife stand in their parched field, faces lifted, laughing as the first heavy rain pours down on them
Heavy rain sweeps across vast cracked farmland from towering clouds
Green shoots spring up from cracked earth after rain
A man sitting low in the dust is lifted to his feet by a friend as rain begins
A rainbow over a soaked green valley

trials.why: beat d1-hill: the man on the bench looked like he was talking to someone; the truck is plainly prayer
beat d2-plain: both show the rain, only the couple shows the lowly lifted up

sections.meaning: God brings the schemes of the clever to nothing, so they grope at noon as if in the dark, and he saves the needy from the strong, so the poor have hope and injustice shuts its mouth.
ideas: At bright noon on a busy city street a man in an expensive suit gropes his way with arms stretched out as if in pitch darkness, while everyone else walks in the sun
A sly man in a sharp suit is caught fast in the very net he stretched across a path for others
A man has fallen into the pit he dug for someone else
A con man's tower of cards collapses
A man lost in a sunlit hedge maze, turning in circles
A strong arm reaches in and holds back a sneering big man who looms over a frail old man in a worn coat
A single green shoot has pushed up through a crack in a heavy slab of concrete
A poor widow holds the keys to her little house, safe on her doorstep
A loud man in a fine suit falls silent as a worker is handed his unpaid wages
A small boat sheltered in a harbour while a great ship passes

trials.why: beat e1-net: the man in the net came out comic, like a hammock
beat e2-shoot: the shoot in concrete says 'hope' but not rescue from the strong, which is most of these verses

sections.meaning: Happy is the one God corrects: the same hands that cause pain also bind up and heal.
ideas: A father, seen only from behind and as careful hands, bandages his young son's scraped knee while the tear-stained boy starts to smile
A vinedresser's hands tie a freshly pruned vine back to its stake, new leaves already growing
A doctor sets a broken arm in a cast while the patient grits his teeth
A gardener prunes a rose bush that is full of new blooms
An old carpenter's hands guide an apprentice's hands on the plane, and the apprentice smiles
A father kneels to talk firmly but kindly with his son eye to eye
A nurse's hands wrap a bandage round an arm
A blacksmith hammers hot iron into shape
A coach corrects a runner's stance
A mother cleans and bandages a cut on her daughter's hand

trials.why: beat f1-prune: the pruned vine needed working out; the bandage is understood at once

sections.meaning: In trouble after trouble he will rescue you, so you need not fear disaster, hunger or wild animals, and even the field and its creatures will be at peace with you.
ideas: A man sleeps peacefully in a warm lamplit bedroom while a fierce storm lashes the window above him
A small stone cottage stands whole and lit on a hill while storms rage all round it
A lighthouse stands firm as wave after wave breaks against it
A woman walks calm and dry under a sturdy umbrella through lashing hail
A family sits safe round a table while a storm passes outside
A grey-haired farmer sits laughing on the low stone wall of his clean field while a deer grazes and a fox sits nearby, unafraid
A man walks calmly through a meadow where a wolf lies peacefully in the grass
A man feeds a deer from his hand at the forest's edge
A clean ploughed field with its stones piled neatly into a wall, deer grazing at the edge
A fox asleep in the sun beside a farm dog

trials.why: beat g1-sleep: both show it, but the man in bed at night would be the third bedroom-at-night picture in a row (Job 4 and 6 have them), and the cottage shows many troubles at once
beat h1-wolf: it shows the laughing, the field and the animals together

sections.meaning: Your home will be at peace with nothing missing, your children as many as the grass, and you will come to the grave in full strength like grain gathered in its season.
ideas: An old couple sit on the porch of their peaceful farmhouse at evening as many children and grandchildren play in a meadow of wildflowers
At night an old man with a small lamp looks in from a doorway on a room where many grandchildren sleep safe in their beds
A grandfather walks hand in hand with a long line of grandchildren through a meadow
Four generations gathered round a great-grandmother holding a newborn
A great old oak with a meadow of young oak saplings round it
A strong grey-haired farmer lifts the last golden sheaf onto a tall stack at the end of harvest
Golden stacks of sheaves stand in rows in a harvested field
An old but vigorous man walks home from his field carrying a sheaf on his shoulder
A full grain barn at harvest
An old man's strong hands hold a ripe sheaf of wheat

trials.why: beat i1-beds: both show it, but the beds picture is another bedroom at night, and the meadow ties to 'like the plants of the earth'
beat j1-stacks: only this one shows 'full vigor' and the stack going up

scenes.principle: Call out if you like: is there anyone who will answer you?
scenes.shows: A lone man stands at the rim of a vast, empty canyon, hands cupped round his mouth, calling out with no one anywhere to answer.
scenes.prompt: A lone man in a plain jacket stands at the rim of a vast, empty canyon under a wide pale overcast sky, his hands cupped round his mouth, calling out across the emptiness. Seen from the side, he is small against the enormous space. The far cliffs are bare rock; there is no one anywhere, no house, no road, nothing that could answer him.

scenes.principle: The fool seemed to have taken root, and suddenly his home was cursed.
scenes.shows: A tall tree beside a showy new house lies toppled, its whole mass of shallow roots torn up out of the lawn.
scenes.prompt: Beside a large, showy new house with big windows, a tall tree that had grown up fast lies toppled across the lawn, its whole mass of shallow roots torn up out of the ground with earth still clinging to them, standing up higher than a man. The house stands silent and empty, its windows dark, under a heavy grey afternoon sky.

scenes.principle: The hungry eat his harvest, taking it even from among the thorns.
scenes.shows: Hungry strangers with sacks reach through thorny brambles to pick the fruit in the orchard of a deserted, overgrown grand house.
scenes.prompt: A grand house stands deserted, its windows dark and its once-fine garden overgrown with tall thorny brambles. In the orchard in front of it, hungry strangers in worn, patched clothes reach in through the thorns to pick the last of the fruit from its trees and fill their sacks. Cool grey morning light.

scenes.principle: Trouble does not sprout from the ground; people are born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.
scenes.shows: From a log fire on bare dark ground, a tall column of sparks streams up into the night sky.
scenes.prompt: A crackling log fire burns at night on bare, dark, dry earth where nothing grows. A tall column of bright orange sparks streams straight up from the flames and rises high into the dark night sky, hundreds of sparks climbing and fading as they go, filling the upper part of the frame.

scenes.principle: I would seek God and lay my cause before him.
scenes.shows: Before sunrise a man in work clothes sits in his parked pickup, hands folded on the wheel, head bowed in prayer, a folder of papers beside him.
scenes.prompt: In the blue light just before sunrise, a man in work clothes sits alone in the driver's seat of his old parked pickup truck, seen through the open side window. His hands are folded on top of the steering wheel, his head is bowed and his eyes are closed in prayer. A worn folder of papers lies on the seat beside him.

scenes.principle: He gives rain on the earth to set the lowly on high.
scenes.shows: A poor farmer and his wife stand in their cracked, parched field, arms open and faces lifted, laughing as the first heavy rain pours down.
scenes.prompt: A poor farmer and his wife in worn clothes stand in their parched, cracked field under a dark grey sky as the first heavy rain pours down on them. Their faces are lifted to the rain and they are laughing with relief, soaked through. Rain streaks the air all round them and the dry earth is darkening as it drinks.

scenes.principle: He brings the schemes of the clever to nothing: at noon they grope as if in the night.
scenes.shows: On a sunny city sidewalk at midday, a man in an expensive suit gropes forward with arms out and unseeing eyes while everyone else walks easily.
scenes.prompt: At bright midday on a busy city sidewalk full of sunshine, a man in an expensive dark suit gropes his way forward with both arms stretched out in front of him and his eyes wide and unseeing, like a man feeling his way through a pitch-dark room, while the people round him walk easily in the bright sunlight. The sun is high overhead and the shadows are short.

scenes.principle: He saves the needy from the hand of the strong, so the poor have hope.
scenes.shows: A frail old man sits against a wall as a big man in an expensive coat looms over him, and another man's arm holds the big man back; the old man looks up with hope.
scenes.prompt: On a city street in afternoon light, a frail old man in a worn, patched coat shrinks back against a brick wall as a big, sneering man in an expensive coat looms over him. A strong arm reaches in between them from the side of the frame and holds the big man back, shielding the old man, who looks up with sudden hope.

scenes.principle: Happy is the one God corrects: he wounds, and his hands heal.
scenes.shows: A father, seen from behind, winds a bandage round his small son's scraped knee; the boy, cheeks still wet, is smiling.
scenes.prompt: In a bright, sunny kitchen, a small boy sits on the counter with his cheeks still wet from crying, starting to smile. His father kneels in front of him, seen from behind and mostly as strong, careful hands and forearms, gently winding a white bandage round the boy's scraped knee. Warm daylight from the window.

scenes.principle: In six troubles he will rescue you, and in seven no evil will touch you.
scenes.shows: A small stone cottage stands untouched on a green hill under clear sky while lightning, hail and rain rage all round it.
scenes.prompt: A small stone cottage with warm light in its windows stands whole and untouched on a green hill, while all round it on every side dark storms rage: lightning to the left, a curtain of hail to the right, wind bending the far trees, rain sweeping the distant hills. Over the cottage itself the sky is clear and calm.

scenes.principle: You will laugh at disaster, and the stones and wild animals of the field will be at peace with you.
scenes.shows: A grey-haired farmer sits laughing on the stone wall of his ploughed field while a deer grazes and a fox sits calmly beside him.
scenes.prompt: In soft morning light at the edge of a clean, well-tilled field bordered by a low stone wall, a grey-haired farmer sits at ease on the wall, laughing out loud. A wild deer grazes calmly a few steps from him and a red fox sits in the grass nearby, neither of them afraid of him.

scenes.principle: Your home will be at peace and your descendants as many as the plants of the earth.
scenes.shows: An old couple sit on the porch of their peaceful farmhouse at evening, watching many children and grandchildren run through a meadow of wildflowers.
scenes.prompt: At evening an old man and his wife sit side by side on the porch of their peaceful farmhouse, its windows glowing warm, looking out with contentment over a meadow thick with wildflowers where many of their children and grandchildren are playing and running together. Everything is calm and in good order.

scenes.principle: You will come to the grave in full vigor, as a stack of grain goes up in its season.
scenes.shows: At the end of harvest a strong grey-haired farmer lifts the last golden sheaf onto a tall stack of sheaves.
scenes.prompt: At the end of harvest in warm late-afternoon light, a grey-haired but strong and vigorous farmer lifts the last golden sheaf of wheat up onto a tall, full stack of sheaves in a harvested field, his arms strong and his face content. The tall stack rises high in the upper part of the frame.
